Chart types of the plotters

Source: R/data.R
plotters.Rd

A table of the plotters (rows) and the chart types (columns) they draw: "x" if the plotter has a wrapper for the chart type. The complete list of chart types and wrappers, with their arguments, is in the chart type and plotter reference.

Usage

data(plotters)

Format

A data frame with column Plotter and one column per chart type (bar, pie, scatter, line, tsline, graph, sankey, ...).

Source

data/plotters.csv of the package.

Examples

plotters[!is.na(plotters$graph), "Plotter"]   # plotters drawing graphs
#> Error: object 'plotters' not found
